''See also: [[Kerian Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Kerian is a dark-skinned [[Heartlander]] woman in her forties who possesses a pale scar running down the center of her face and hair styled into hundreds of small braids. A former [[assassin]] with extensive experience, she previously served as the head of the [[Gardeners]]. She currently holds a leadership position as one of three leaders within the [[Consultant's Guild]] and is a member of the [[Council of Architects]], with aspirations toward becoming a [[High Councilor]]. Despite her background in assassination, she has acted as a proven ally to [[Shera]] over many years. Physically, she uses a sturdy cane or crutch due to a knee injury caused by a recent physical altercation. In her professional capacity, she has demonstrated a range of temperaments, from maintaining a neutral and pleasant facade to displaying sudden, lethal aggression with a bronze blade. She is also noted for her ability to manage complex political and organizational matters, such as appointing new [[Gardeners]] and overseeing the movement of valuables at a chapter house.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Kerian is a dark-skinned [[Heartlander]] woman who wears purple clothing and carries a leather satchel. Her face features a long white scar running down the center, along with an additional mark on her forehead.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|As an [[assassin]], she does not believe that murder is the answer to every problem. She acts as a cautious mentor who warns others against entering contracts with untrustworthy individuals.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|A trained [[Gardener]] and born [[Imperial Guard]], she is an exceptional leader who serves as the head of the [[Gardeners]]. She utilizes [[shears]] that have grown broad and shine with a deep blue light, and she possesses the power to collapse the [[Bastion's Veil]].}}

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|“We have,” Yala said, firmly taking the reins of the conversation back from Kerian.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c4" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|“I want you to eat quietly, while my former student and I have a nice talk.”<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c5" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|“Back away from the box,” Kerian said calmly, pulling her own set of shears.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c13" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Kerian’s words were more careful. “That’s not untrue, but it is difficult to enter into a contract with someone we know we can’t trust.”<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25" />}}
